title: calystegia spithamaea subsp. purshiana
intro: Calystegia spithamaea subsp. purshiana, commonly known as Western false bindweed, is a flowering vine plant native to North America. Western false bindweed has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to lower body temperature, reduce swelling, and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Western false bindweed include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as calystegine and purshianic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
